proof: Phase 5 — provider list and page-image fetch, exercised live
method: The shipped main-process modules were bundled with only seanime/supervisor stubbed (it imports electron) and run against a real supervised sidecar plus a fake provider CDN that refuses requests missing the provider header.

sidecar.note: Isolated Phase 3/5 test profile. Study OS userData untouched.

readingMangaProviders.note: GET /api/v1/extensions/list/manga-provider through the shipped fetchMangaProviders, including its sort-by-display-name rule.

readingMangaPageImage.note: The CDN 403s any request without the provider header, so a 200 here proves the header survived the boundary into main and out to the CDN.

headerNegativeControl.note: Exactly what an in the renderer would have done. It fails loudly instead of rendering a blank page.

guards.htmlBody: Page responded with "text/html", which is not an image.
guards.fileUrl: Page URL protocol "file:" is not fetchable.
